fullHistoryCatalog.name: waitlist_entries_ip_created_idx
fullHistoryCatalog.sql:
CREATE INDEX waitlist_entries_ip_created_idx
  ON waitlist_entries (ip_hash, created_at)

fullHistoryCatalog.name: waitlist_email_outbox
fullHistoryCatalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE waitlist_email_outbox (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES waitlist_entries(email),
  request_body TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'inflight', 'accepted', 'failed', 'unknown')),
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  claim_id TEXT,
  first_attempt_at INTEGER,
  retry_until INTEGER,
  lease_until INTEGER,
  provider_email_id TEXT,
  last_error_code TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

fullHistoryCatalog.name: waitlist_entries
fullHistoryCatalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE waitlist_entries (
  email TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

fullHistoryCatalog.name: waitlist_rate_limits
fullHistoryCatalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE waitlist_rate_limits (
  ip_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL
)
